newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Peerless started with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Peerless started with buy.

text.p: - Dain Bosworth said it started coverage with a buy rating of Peerless Group Inc, which provides services, including check imaging systems, to community banks and credit unions.
- Dain Bosworth estimates Peerless Group's fiscal 1996 operating earnings on a fully taxed basis at $0.41 a share, up from $0.32 a year ago, according to a report.
- Shares of Peerless Group, which went public last month, were trading unchanged at eight.
